## R Markdown

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(ggmap)
library(sf)
library(osmdata)

my_data = read.csv("ECOLI_W_API.csv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
head(my_data)
```

```{r}
my_data = my_data %>%
  filter(!is.na(LATITUDE), !is.na(LONGITUDE), !is.na(RESULT..MPN.100ML.))
```

```{r}
# Load required libraries
library(leaflet)
library(viridis)

# Custom scaling functions
scaled_radius <- function(x) {
  return(log(x + 1))  # Apply log scale to compress high values
}

color_palette <- colorNumeric(palette = "plasma", domain = my_data$RESULT..MPN.100ML.)

leaflet(my_data) %>%
  addTiles() %>%
  addCircleMarkers(
    ~LONGITUDE, ~LATITUDE, 
    color = ~color_palette(RESULT..MPN.100ML.),
    radius = ~scaled_radius(RESULT..MPN.100ML.),
    opacity = 0.7,
    fill = TRUE,
    fillOpacity = 0.7,
    popup = ~paste("E. coli Concentration: ", RESULT..MPN.100ML., "MPN/100ML"),
    stroke = FALSE
  ) %>%
  addLegend(
    "bottomright", 
    pal = color_palette,
    values = my_data$RESULT..MPN.100ML.,
    title = "E. coli Concentration (MPN/100ML)"
  ) %>%
  addControl(
    html = "<strong>E. coli Concentrations in Austin</strong>",
    position = "topright"
  ) %>%
  addControl(
    html = "Longitude (x-axis)",
    position = "bottomleft"
  ) %>%
  addControl(
    html = "Latitude (y-axis)",
    position = "topleft"
  ) %>%
  addMarkers(lng = -97.6986342297922, lat = 30.336339104103, popup = "Buttermilk Branch", label = "Buttermilk Branch") %>%
  addMarkers(lng = -97.74810283, lat = 30.27060332, popup = "Shoal Creek", label = "Shoal Creek") %>%
  addMarkers(lng = -97.6092289657427, lat = 30.2921531272374, popup = "Walter E. Long Lake", label = "Walter E. Long Lake") %>%
  addMarkers(lng = -97.73372, lat = 30.285845, popup = "Waller Creek", label = "Waller Creek") %>%
  setView(lng = -97.74, lat = 30.27, zoom = 11)
```

```{r}
# Load required libraries
library(ggplot2)
library(scales)

filtered_data <- my_data %>% 
  filter(WATERSHED %in% c("Buttermilk Branch", "Shoal Creek", "Walter E. Long Lake", "Waller Creek"))

ggplot(filtered_data, aes(x = RESULT..MPN.100ML.)) + 
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 2500, fill = "skyblue", color = "black", alpha = 0.7) +
  facet_wrap(~ WATERSHED, ncol = 2, scales = "free_y") +
  labs(
    title = "Spread of E. coli Concentrations Across Random Watersheds",
    x = "E. coli Concentration (MPN/100ML)",
    y = "Frequency"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    strip.text = element_text(size = 10, face = "bold"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1), 
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "lightgray")
  )

```

```{r}
ggplot(my_data, aes(x = RESULT..MPN.100ML.)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 2000, fill = "skyblue", color = "black", alpha = 0.7) +
  labs(
    title = "Distribution of E. coli Concentrations",
    x = "E. coli Concentration (MPN/100ML)",
    y = "Frequency"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    plot.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold")
  )
```

```{r}
ggplot(my_data %>% filter(RESULT..MPN.100ML. > 3000), aes(x = RESULT..MPN.100ML.)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 1000, fill = "skyblue", color = "black", alpha = 0.7) +
  labs(
    title = "Distribution of High E. coli Concentrations (>3000 MPN/100ML)",
    x = "E. coli Concentration (MPN/100ML)",
    y = "Frequency"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    plot.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold")
  )
```
